features: 100% Cotton: YouHaveSpace pillow covers are made of environmental friendly durable cotton. They are skin friendly for you and your family!
Practical Design: These throw pillow covers with zipper closure makes easier to fill your pillow insert. Pillow cases also easy to clean and take care with its machine washable cushion.

Upgrade Your Room Decor: Cover up your couch pillows, fluffy pillows, sofa pillows, decorative pillows for bed and more. Boho pillow covers are also great for guest room with its durable and high quality fabric.

Fits Anywhere: Besides in the house usage, YouHaveSpace pillow covers also great for your office, cafe, outdoor bench, car or window seat. Choose the color you like and bright up anywhere to your liking!
Package Includes: Buyer receives 2 pack of 100% cotton black cushion covers for 20"x20" pillow set. Pillow insert is not included.
description: These pillowcases are great to cover throw pillows for couch, fluffy pillows or any pillow set sized 20x20. With bright colors and modern texture, you can easily place them in living room, bedroom, dining room, divan, bench, kids room, balcony, office and anywhere to your liking to create an aesthetic room decor!
Machine washable, warm 104 F (40°C). Do not bleach. Do not tumble dry. You can iron with medium temperature. Do not dryclean.
